changes_made.explanation: Added Dialogue Generation task based on MT-Bench/Vicuna evaluations. Removed Image Captioning as it's not evaluated for NLG outputs. Added missing dialogue datasets. Normalized model names to specific versions. Removed generic model names (BART, LLaMA) in favor of specific variants mentioned.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE following simplification guidelines. All metrics correctly extracted from E2E benchmark description.

Removed specific criteria (fluency, relevance, helpfulness, coherence) as they are not explicitly mentioned in the evaluation methodology. The paper only mentions GPT-4 scoring on a 10-point scale without specifying detailed criteria. Normalized method descriptions.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methodology (MaCP) with NLG tasks as one of several evaluation domains. NLG evaluation is limited to automatic metrics for E2E dataset and LLM-as-judge for instruction-following tasks. Extraction quality was generally good but needed refinement for specificity and accuracy.
